    • attachListeners

      void attachListeners(GuideFlow f)
      Attaches listeners for this guide. It attaches itself to the provided GuideFlow and also attaches itself as a listener to the `listeningTo` EventEmitterInterface, if set.
      Parameters:
      f - The GuideFlow to which this GuideInfo should attach its listener.

    • build

      public void build(GuidePanelAdapter adapter)
      Builds the UI components for this guide step using the provided adapter. Subclasses should override this method to define their specific guide content.
      Parameters:
      adapter - The GuidePanelAdapter used to add and manage UI components.

    • close

      public void close()
      Initiates the closing process for this guide step. It broadcasts a EventType.GUIDE_CLOSING event with a GuideInfoClosingPayload.

    • breakdown

      public void breakdown()
      Cleans up the guide step by removing all associated UI components from the adapter and detaching itself as a listener from the `listeningTo` EventEmitterInterface, if it was attached.

    • getComponents

      public ArrayList<Component> getComponents()
      Returns the list of UI components associated with this guide step.
      Returns:
      An ArrayList of Component objects managed by this guide step.

    • getId

      public UUID getId()
      Returns the unique identifier for this guide step.
      Returns:

    • guideCounter

      public void guideCounter(GuidePanelAdapter adapter)
      Displays a guide counter (e.g., "1 of 5") on the guide panel. The counter indicates the current guide step's position within the overall flow.
      Parameters:
      adapter - The GuidePanelAdapter to which the counter label will be added.

    • image

      public JLabel image(URL url, double scale)
      Creates and returns a JLabel containing an image loaded from the given URL, scaled by the specified factor.
      Parameters:
      url - The URL of the image to load.
      scale - The scaling factor to apply to the image (e.g., 0.5 for half size).
      Returns:
      A JLabel with the scaled image icon.
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if there is a URISyntaxException when converting the URL to a URI.

    • genericText

      public void genericText(GuidePanelAdapter adapter, String text)
      Adds a generic text label to the guide panel at a predefined position (SOUTH | WEST). The text is styled using InlineHTML with a specific font color and size.
      Parameters:
      adapter - The GuidePanelAdapter to which the text label will be added.
      text - The string content to display in the label.

    • addCompAtCentre

      public void addCompAtCentre(GuidePanelAdapter adapter, Component l, int offX, int offY)
      Adds a component to the center of the guide panel with specified X and Y offsets. The component is also added to this guide's internal list of components.
      Parameters:
      adapter - The GuidePanelAdapter to which the component will be added.
      l - The Component to add.
      offX - The horizontal offset from the center.
      offY - The vertical offset from the center.

    • addCompAtCentre

      public void addCompAtCentre(GuidePanelAdapter adapter, Component l)
      Adds a component to the center of the guide panel with no offset. The component is also added to this guide's internal list of components.
      Parameters:
      adapter - The GuidePanelAdapter to which the component will be added.
      l - The Component to add.

    • addCompAt

      public void addCompAt(GuidePanelAdapter adapter, Component l, int anchor, int offX, int offY)
      Adds a component to the guide panel at a position determined by an anchor and offsets. The component is also added to this guide's internal list of components.
      Parameters:
      adapter - The GuidePanelAdapter to which the component will be added.
      l - The Component to add.
      anchor - A bitmask representing the desired anchor point (e.g., Anchor.NORTH, Anchor.SOUTH, Anchor.EAST, Anchor.WEST, Anchor.CENTRE).
      offX - The horizontal offset from the calculated anchor position. (Use Anchor.offsetRight(int) and Anchor.offsetLeft(int))
      offY - The vertical offset from the calculated anchor position. (Use Anchor.offsetUp(int) and Anchor.offsetDown(int))

    • addCompAt

      public void addCompAt(GuidePanelAdapter adapter, Component l, int anchor)
      Adds a component to the guide panel at a position determined by an anchor with no offsets. The component is also added to this guide's internal list of components.
      Parameters:
      adapter - The GuidePanelAdapter to which the component will be added.
      l - The Component to add.
      anchor - A bitmask representing the desired anchor point (e.g., Anchor.NORTH, Anchor.SOUTH, Anchor.EAST, Anchor.WEST, Anchor.CENTRE).
